newsitem.title: ITALY: Several hurt as plane overshoots Italian runway.
newsitem.headline: Several hurt as plane overshoots Italian runway.

text.p: At least five people were injured on Wednesday when a small airliner overshot a runway at Florence airport and partially broke up after hitting a highway fence, Italian officials said.
The Air Littoral ATR-42 turbo prop plane on a flight from Nice in southern France was carrying some 14 passengers.
The passengers were all taken off the plane but the pilots were believed to be in a serious condition.
"At the moment there are at least four or five injured and the pilots are still trapped inside," Luciano Buonpane, a national fire brigades spokesman in Rome, told Reuters.
"The ATR broke on impact with the ground but it did not land on the highway itself."
It was not clear what part or how much of the small plane had broken off.
"The highway is closed to allow movement of rescue vehicles," Buonpane said.
Fire brigades had said earlier that there was a danger of an explosion but later reports said the situation was under control.
